description: Source code for a Bluetooth driver class (Broadcom43XX) handling firmware loading, MAC address configuration, and device initialization, including external C interface functions for driver management.

classes.name: Broadcom43XX
classes.description: A class representing a Bluetooth driver for Broadcom 43XX chips, managing firmware, MAC address, and device setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up the Broadcom43XX driver, including port, firmware path, baud rate, MAC address, and other options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth device, loads firmware, sets MAC address, and configures the driver.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Sends a reset command to the Bluetooth chip.

methods.name: LoadName
methods.description: Reads the local name of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: SetSpeed
methods.description: Sets the communication speed (baud rate) of the device.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Configures the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: Firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware into the device from specified directory.

methods.name: GetDeviceMAC
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device from system adapters.
